throughput_tok_s_r290_vs_r224.reading: Above the point where R224 needs a second piece the gain is large and monotone: TP1 depth 3 +22% at c16, +38% at c32, +51% at c64, +55% at c128; TP2 depth 3 +34% at c64; TP1 MTP0 +26% at c64, +40% at c128; TP2 MTP0 +16% at c64, +29% at c128 (4017 tok/s, the highest aggregate measured on this lane). Below it every rung LOSES 8-15%: the pad path allocated a zero block and concatenated on every call, and with ~50-100 unquantized projections per step that is 2-3 ms per step at single user.

identity.reading: R224 kept MTP0 near-exact to c128 and the depth-3 suite exact to c16. R290 keeps depth 3 exact to c8-c16 and MTP0 exact to c16 on one card, then loses it. Two cards are much less affected. The oracle-free minority rate of 5% at c24 says passes disagree with each other, not only with the oracle.

diagnosis.offline: probes/validate-r290-classpad.py and a TP1-shape variant: the R290 op is bit-identical across M in {1..600}, to 64 single-row calls, with bias, with strided and 3-D inputs, for 12288x2560, 10240x2560, 2560x4096 and 248320x2560. The arithmetic is not the fault.
diagnosis.the_census: The server's own census line for 2560x4096 read 'canonical=c1 largest=512 map=1-32:c0 33-192:c1 193-193:c2 ...' while offline the same shape maps as '33-96:c1 97-192:c2 ...' with largest=384. A class was a row-0 fingerprint on ONE random input, and two kernels that agree on that input merge. On the server that merged 33-96 with 97-192 and admitted members up to 512 - and offline, every class of the small-N shapes from 129 rows up is split-K: position-variant, pad-variant and run-to-run nondeterministic (probes/census-small-shapes.py). Prefill chunks of several prompts land there, so the state after prefill differed between passes: divergence from c20 up, oracle-free minority 5%, TP2 (different shapes, different maps) barely affected.
diagnosis.the_cost: Per call, zero-block allocation + cat + slice adds 0.02-0.03 ms on the small shapes (0.093 -> 0.115 ms at 10240x2560); a persistent buffer adds 0.002 ms (0.095). Times ~75 calls per step that is the 12%.

r291.what: experiments/qwen38-27b-b70/docker/r291-fp16-linear-classpad-verified.py on R290 -> image qwen38-int4-fp16-linear-classpad-verified-r291 sha256:4f97c239. Three-input fingerprints; a class is canonical-eligible only if deterministic, position-invariant and pad-invariant at its first, middle and last member; canonical = most populous eligible class other than the single-row class; no eligible class -> R224 32-row pieces for that shape; pad rows from a persistent zeroed buffer; verdict logged per shape.
r291.offline: bit-exact at every M for every logged shape; lm_head M=1 2.23 ms (plain 2.12), M=256 3.04, M=512 4.40; TP2 shard M=1 1.20 (1.08).
